jdLines.text: Break complex marketing problems into structured hypotheses and research plans
Conduct deep trend, search intent & cultural analysis for the Bangladeshi market
Perform competitor gap analysis to identify untapped opportunities
Support A/B testing and document "Failure Reports" & "Success Frameworks"
Convert messy data into clear, leadership-ready insights
Ability to interpret GA4 & Meta Analytics
Comfortable using AI tools for research

phases.title: Problem Framing & First-Principles Thinking
phases.course: Problem Solving Skills and Critical Thinking (Wiley Skills Network)

modules.title: Mod 2: Define the Problem
modules.description: SMART problem statements, KPIs, explicit scope

modules.title: Mod 3: Problem Disaggregation & Prioritization
modules.description: MECE logic trees, hypothesis trees, pruning to root causes

modules.title: Mod 4: Build a Great Workplan & Team Processes
modules.description: Chunky vs lean plans, one-day answers, bias checks

modules.title: Mod 5: Conduct Analyses
modules.description: Question-based problem solving

modules.title: Note
modules.description: (Mod 1 is the overview; the Mod 6 reading on A/B testing feeds Phase 7; Mod 7 feeds Phase 8.)

phases.application: Take a vague brief (e.g., "why did category conversion drop last month?") and decompose it from first principles: revenue = traffic × conversion rate × average order value. Turn each branch into a testable hypothesis.
phases.deliverable: One-page research plan: issue tree, ranked hypotheses, data source and method per branch, and the result that would change the decision.

phases.title: AI-Assisted Research Workflow

modules.title: AI Essentials, Course 3: Discover the Art of Prompting
modules.description: Clear, specific prompts; few-shot prompting; refining output

modules.title: AI Essentials, Course 4: Use AI Responsibly
modules.description: Bias, inaccuracy, privacy and security risks

modules.title: Prompting Essentials (supporting): a five-step prompting method reusable across tools, including checking outputs for bias and errors
Note
modules.description: Tool-agnostic: the JD says "AI tools", not a product.

phases.application: Use AI to speed up desk research — landscape scans, question trees, summarising long sources — but treat every output as unverified until traced to a primary source.
phases.deliverable: Verification log: 10 AI-generated claims about the Bangladeshi book market, each traced to a primary source and marked confirmed or unsupported.

phases.title: Data Ingestion, Cleaning & Aggregation
phases.course: Excel Skills for Data Analytics & Visualization + Google Sheets

modules.title: DA&V C1, Mod 1: Cleaning & Manipulating Text
DA&V C1, Mod 4: Tables for Automating Data Manipulation
DA&V C1, Mod 5: Logical & Lookup Functions (IF, VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH)
ESB C2, Mod 6: Pivot Tables, Charts & Slicers
Google Sheets: QUERY, ARRAYFORMULA and IMPORTRANGE, plus pivot tables
modules.description: Rebuild each Excel exercise above in Sheets

modules.title: Stretch only: ESB C4, Mod 5 (INDIRECT / ADDRESS / OFFSET). Excel Tables already extend automatically; INDIRECT and OFFSET recalculate on every edit.

phases.application: Strip and normalise UTM parameters and campaign names from Meta Ads and GA4 exports into a table-driven intake sheet, pivot it by channel, and keep a Google Sheets twin.
phases.deliverable: Entry diagnostic + a refreshable intake → pivot → summary in both tools, with a data-dictionary tab.

phases.title: Measurement Platforms — GA4 & Meta Analytics

modules.title: GA 101: Get started using Google Analytics
GA 102: Manage GA data and learn to read reports
GA 201: Dive deeper into GA data and reports
Optional: GA 301 (use GA with other tools and data sources); Google Analytics Certification
Meta Blueprint: choosing objectives and measuring success; finding key metrics in Ads Manager and using them to analyse results; Meta Pixel and Conversions API basics

phases.application: Learn what each number means (GA4 sessions vs Ads Manager results) and why platforms never reconcile exactly (attribution rules). Read one real funnel end to end.
phases.deliverable: Metric definition sheet (15 metrics) + one-week reconciliation note comparing GA4 sessions with Meta link clicks.

phases.title: Trend, Search-Intent & Cultural Analysis
phases.course: Google SEO Fundamentals + Google Trends / Search Console

modules.title: Google Trends: the 0–100 index is relative interest, not search volume; it rescales when you change region, period or terms and is built from a sample
modules.description: Use it for seasonality and momentum

modules.title: Search Console Performance report: queries, clicks, impressions, CTR and position for Rokomari's own site only
modules.description: Not competitors'

modules.title: SEO Fundamentals, Mod 4: keyword research, intent mapping and the stages of search
modules.description: Then tag each query yourself by intent (for example informational vs transactional)

modules.title: DataReportal: internet, mobile and platform reach for Bangladesh
modules.description: Cross-check user counts against regulator subscriber data (subscriptions ≠ people)

modules.title: Culture, bottom-up first: comments, reviews and community groups in Bangla, English and romanised Bangla; the calendar of book fair, exams, Ramadan and Eid. Hofstede scores only to generate hypotheses
modules.description: They are national-level and dated

phases.application: Build a Bangladesh demand calendar and an intent-tagged query map for Rokomari's main categories. Test hypotheses against actual date shifts (e.g., Book fair in Ramadan).
phases.deliverable: 3-page Bangladesh Trend & Intent Brief: demand calendar, intent map of 50+ queries, three cultural drivers with evidence.

phases.title: Competitor Gap Analysis
phases.course: Business Strategy: Creating Competitive Advantage (IBM) + Meta Ad Library

modules.title: IBM, Mod 1: Strategic Analysis Fundamentals
modules.description: SWOT, PESTEL, Porter's Five Forces, competitive-intelligence demo

modules.title: IBM, Mod 2: Strategic Frameworks & Tools
modules.description: Positioning, Blue Ocean strategy-canvas demo, market sizing and opportunity assessment

modules.title: Meta Ad Library: shows competitors' live creative, copy, platforms and start dates. For ordinary commercial ads outside the EU it shows no spend, targeting or results, and paused ads drop out
modules.description: Capture ads while they are live

modules.title: Strategy canvas + ERRC (eliminate / reduce / raise / create) to turn observations into gaps
Supporting: Microsoft course on market gaps and personas
modules.description: B2B-oriented; needs a Microsoft 365 licence or trial

phases.application: Score competitors (Wafilife, Daraz, etc.) on range, price, delivery, trust. Plot value curves, list gaps as hypotheses, rank by impact/effort.
phases.deliverable: Competitor gap matrix + ranked opportunity list with testable hypotheses.

phases.title: Experimentation — A/B Test Design, Evaluation

modules.title: Udacity Lesson 3: Choosing & Characterizing Metrics
Udacity Lesson 4: Designing an Experiment
Udacity Lesson 5: Analyzing Results
Udacity Lesson 2 (recommended): Policy & Ethics for Experiments
Forecasting C2 (supporting): Excel Data Analysis tools and regression
modules.description: Use to test a treatment effect and read p-values and confidence intervals in Excel

modules.title: Cross-reference: Phase 1 course, Mod 6 reading on RCTs and A/B testing

phases.application: Design before you run: hypothesis, primary metric, guardrail metrics, MDE, sample size. Write every test up blamelessly.
phases.deliverable: Reusable Test Plan and Test Report templates + one retrospective write-up of a past campaign.

phases.title: Insight Synthesis & Leadership Communication
phases.course: Data Visualization in Excel + Problem Solving Mod 7

DA&V C2, Mod 5: Creating interactive dashboards in Excel
ESB C4, Mod 1: Spreadsheet Design & Documentation
ESB C4, Mod 6: Building Professional Dashboards
Problem Solving, Mod 7: Synthesize Results & Tell a Great Story
modules.description: Pyramid structure, one-day answers, handling difficult audiences

modules.title: Mod 1–2: Power Query
modules.description: Importing, combining and transforming in the Query Editor

modules.title: Mod 3: Power Pivot & the Data Model
modules.description: Table relationships; beyond the ~1.05m-row worksheet limit, bounded only by memory

modules.title: Business Indicators, Subjective Assessment Methods, Exploratory Methods, and the role of bias

phases.application: Turn Phase 3–7 outputs into a one-page leadership brief: answer first, three findings, decision requested, confidence.
phases.deliverable: One-page leadership brief + 5-minute readout deck/script; searchable Failure/Success library index.
